classification.question_topic: Asking if others experience being watched/surveilled and arrested in Mall World; asks what it means

meta.author_theory: Describes it as a run-down/abandoned 'facility' with a 'knowing' of being watched/studied; later 'up and running again' with an 'experimental element' (as stated by author)

qualities.raw_description: Described as a "facility"; initially "more run-down and abandoned"; later "up and running again"; dreamer has a "knowing" they are "being watched or studied"; feels like "wasn't supposed to be there or get caught"; later people show up and can engage; recurring arrests occur here

interactions.description: Dreamer is alone "observing and exploring" the facility; has a persistent sense of being watched/studied by an unknown watcher; feels they are not supposed to be there and might get caught, yet is somehow allowed to remain.

entities_involved.description: Unknown who/what is watching or studying the dreamer

interactions.description: Over time, other people begin showing up; initially the dreamer is "still going unseen" until later it seems the others can see the dreamer and they can engage.

entities_involved.description: People present in the facility; at first do not perceive the dreamer, later can see/engage

interactions.description: Police linger around the dreamer and eventually arrest them; dreamer never knows why and is not told; police are not necessarily aggressive; dreamer goes peacefully.

entities_involved.description: Police who linger and then arrest the dreamer without explanation

interactions.description: During one arrest, the dreamer is cuffed and blindfolded and is "not allowed to see where" they are being taken.

entities_involved.description: Police transporting the dreamer while blindfolded and cuffed

interactions.description: During another arrest, the dreamer is tied up with "muddy rope" instead of cuffs and removed again without knowing what they did.

entities_involved.description: Arrest/transport using muddy rope bindings rather than handcuffs

interactions.description: A police woman appears to take pity or think the dreamer is innocent and tries to help by giving a coin (called a "veterans coin") said to be worth something and implied to help with the arrest.

entities_involved.description: Police woman who gives the dreamer a coin called a "veterans coin" to help

interactions.description: Dreamer stumbles upon envelopes with their name on them containing surveillance photos of the dreamer walking around/exploring the facility.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes a recurring setting ('facility'/mall world) and recurring events (surveillance, arrests) but gives minimal concrete layout (no specific rooms/levels or explicit paths). Temporal sequence is present across years and across repeated arrest variants, but not within a single night’s timeline.
